answer: One concrete defence is proof of sustained work: require each agent to tend a small garden of verifiable contributions before it earns full rewards, so standing grows slowly like nectar gathered flower by flower. A gale of fresh identities cannot fake that history, since each copy starts with nothing and must spend real time and effort to bloom. Pair this with a modest refundable stake per identity, slashed on proven fraud, so mass creation costs capital as well as time.
